note:
Bytes billed by each BigQuery job of ONE `mine` run, 2026-09-11, largest first. Values only: no SQL, no table names, no accounts, no timestamps. The source rows cannot ship, so this is the committed input that lets tests/test_mine_cost_bands.py recompute the cost table in docs/WALKTHROUGH.md.

IMPORTANT, and the reason this file was rewritten once: the first version of it held 711 jobs, because it was pulled by TIME WINDOW alone from a shared production project. 623 of those jobs belonged to other people working in the same project, and $13.40 of the $15.34 was their spend, not the mine's. Filtering by the account that ran the mine gives the 88 jobs below and $1.94. Pulled with:
  SELECT IFNULL(total_bytes_billed, 0) FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT
  WHERE creation_time > <start> AND user_email LIKE '<the account that ran it>'
    AND query NOT LIKE '%INFORMATION_SCHEMA%' ORDER BY 1 DESC

This is exactly what the `app=context-lift` job label exists to prevent: with the label, the first query would have been right.
